# TSMC 2026 Supply Chain Management Forum Presents Awards to Outstanding Suppliers


##


Issued by: TSMC


Issued on: 2026/11/17


[TSMC 2026 Supply Chain Management Forum Presents Awards to Outstanding Suppliers](https://pr.tsmc.com/system/files/newspdf/attachment/1e7873e182523d3351afd810dc413e0bce01ca5f/2026%20Supply%20Chain%20Management%20Forum%20Press%20Release%20%28E%29-final_wmn.pdf)


**HSINCHU, Taiwan, R.O.C. – Nov. 17, 2026** - TSMC (TWSE: 2330, NYSE: TSM) held its 2026 Supply Chain Management Forum to express gratitude to global partners for their enduring trust and support. From critical materials and equipment to professional services, the robust support of suppliers continues to fuel TSMC’s growth. As AI and high-performance computing (HPC) usher in a new era of semiconductor-driven innovation, TSMC will continue to collaborate with its supply chain to advance technology, expand its global footprint, and build a sustainable future together.


In line with the forum’s theme of "Grand Alliance for a New Era," Jonathan Lee, TSMC’s Senior Vice President of the Corporate Planning Organization, spoke on strengthening collaborative innovation across technology and system integration amid the AI wave. The address also highlighted shared success achieved through local procurement, supply chain resilience, capacity expansion, and green manufacturing. Double-award recipients recognized for their excellence in technology, production, and global support were also invited to share insights on efficient capacity ramp-up and strategies that balance global capabilities with local commitments.


The forum featured breakout sessions covering IT, Facility, and Advanced Packaging. In Facility operations, TSMC upholds the highest safety standards in fab construction by reducing risks through design-for-safety, systematic protection, and digital technologies to enhance onsite management. Contractors were also invited to share best practices in occupational safety and low-carbon construction, aiming to elevate an industry safety culture and foster a safe, efficient, and sustainable construction environment.


"Amid macroeconomic uncertainties, TSMC’s confidence in continuous investment and growth stems from the deep trust we share with our supply chain partners," said Dr. C.C. Wei, TSMC Chairman and CEO. "Our goal has always been to unleash our customers' innovation and enable their success. Only through the close and agile collaboration of the grand alliance can we overcome challenges and transform technology breakthroughs into powerful momentum driving the industry forward."


"We will continue enhancing supply chain resilience through local engagement and sustainable risk management," said Dr. Cliff Hou, TSMC Senior Vice President and Deputy Co-COO. "Workplace safety is our non-negotiable goal, taking precedence over any progress, capacity, or engineering milestones. This is a steadfast commitment shared and upheld by TSMC and all our partners."


During the event, Dr. Wei and Dr. Hou, along with Executive Vice President and Co-COO Y.P. Chin, Senior Vice President and CFO Wendell Huang, Senior Vice President Dr. Y.L. Wang, TSMC Senior Fellow and Senior Vice President Dr. T.S. Chang, and Senior Vice President Jonathan Lee presented the 2026 TSMC Excellent Performance Awards to recognize outstanding suppliers for their contributions to industry excellence. This year's evaluation placed greater emphasis on overall performance in construction safety, sustainability, global support, and localization.
